attach-file-from-byte-array-to-pdf.title: Attach Byte Array as Embedded File to PDF
attach-file-from-byte-array-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a FileSpecification from a byte array using a MemoryStream and embed it into a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Attachments to a PDF
add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf.description: Shows how to attach several files to an existing PDF by iterating a collection of file paths, creating FileSpecification objects, and saving the updated document.

set-custom-description-for-pdf-attachmen.title: Set Custom Description and MIME Type for PDF Attachments
set-custom-description-for-pdf-attachmen.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through its embedded file attachments, assigns a custom description and appropriate MIME type to each attachment, and saves the updated PDF.

list-pdf-attachment-names-sizes.title: List PDF Embedded Attachments and Their Sizes
list-pdf-attachment-names-sizes.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access the EmbeddedFiles collection, iterate through each attachment, and display its name and size in bytes.

extract-specific-attachment-from-pdf.title: Extract a Specific Attachment from a PDF
extract-specific-attachment-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate an embedded file in a PDF by its name and save it to a target directory using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-attachments-to-subfolders.title: Extract PDF Attachments to Separate Subfolders
extract-pdf-attachments-to-subfolders.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its embedded files and writes each attachment into its own subfolder under a root directory. Handles missing files and streams safely.

remove-pdf-attachment-by-index.title: Remove PDF Attachment by Index
remove-pdf-attachment-by-index.description: Shows how to delete an embedded file from a PDF using its zero‑based index with Aspose.Pdf, including validation and index conversion.

delete-pdf-attachment-by-filename.title: Delete PDF Attachment by Filename
delete-pdf-attachment-by-filename.description: Demonstrates how to remove an embedded file from a PDF by matching its filename using Aspose.PDF.

extract-pdf-attachment-metadata.title: Extract PDF Attachment Metadata to JSON
extract-pdf-attachment-metadata.description: Shows how to read embedded file information from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write the attachment metadata, including creation date, to a JSON file.

add-attachment-to-password-protected-pdf.title: Add Attachment to Password-Protected PDF
add-attachment-to-password-protected-pdf.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF with Aspose.Pdf, embed a file attachment, and save the updated document.

extract-attachments-from-encrypted-pdf.title: Extract Attachments from an Encrypted PDF
extract-attachments-from-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open a password‑protected PDF, decrypt it, and extract all embedded file attachments to a folder using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-attachment-size-before-adding-t.title: Validate Attachment Size Before Adding to PDF
validate-attachment-size-before-adding-t.description: Shows how to enforce a maximum file size limit and embed only qualifying files as attachments in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-attachment-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Attachment to Multiple PDFs
batch-add-attachment-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate over a directory of PDF files and embed the same external file as an attachment into each document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-pdf-attachments-to-zip.title: Batch Extract PDF Attachments to a ZIP Archive
batch-extract-pdf-attachments-to-zip.description: Shows how to iterate over multiple PDF files, extract their embedded attachments, and consolidate them into a single ZIP archive using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-portfolio-with-attachments.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded Files
create-pdf-portfolio-with-attachments.description: Shows how to build a PDF Portfolio document and embed multiple files using Aspose.Pdf's Document, Collection, and FileSpecification classes.

add-word-document-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Word Document to PDF Portfolio
add-word-document-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed a Word (.docx) file into an existing PDF portfolio using Aspose.Pdf's Collection.Add method.

insert-excel-into-pdf-portfolio.title: Embed Excel Workbook into PDF Portfolio with Description
insert-excel-into-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to open an existing PDF portfolio, embed an Excel workbook as an attachment with a custom description, set MIME type and relationship for PDF/A‑3 compliance, and save the updated PDF.

embed-image-into-pdf-portfolio.title: Embed Image into PDF Portfolio with Custom Display Name
embed-image-into-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to turn an existing PDF into a portfolio, embed an image file as an attachment, and set a custom display name for the attachment using Aspose.Pdf.

add-nested-pdf-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Embedded PDF to Existing PDF Portfolio
add-nested-pdf-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF file as a nested item inside an existing PDF Portfolio using Aspose.Pdf. The example opens a portfolio, creates a file specification for the PDF, adds it to the collection, and saves the result.

add-multiple-files-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Multiple Files to a PDF Portfolio in a Single Loop
add-multiple-files-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates embedding various file types into a PDF portfolio by creating a FileSpecification for each file and adding them to the document's collection within a single loop.

compress-pdf-portfolio-with-optimization.title: Compress PDF Portfolio Using Optimization Options
compress-pdf-portfolio-with-optimization.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF Portfolio, configure optimization settings to compress objects, streams, and images, and save the compressed result.

extract-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.title: Extract Embedded File from PDF Portfolio by Index
extract-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to open a PDF portfolio, retrieve an embedded file using its 1‑based index, and save it to disk with the original file name and extension.

remove-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.title: Remove Embedded File from PDF Portfolio by Index
remove-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific embedded file from a PDF Portfolio using its zero‑based collection index and save the updated portfolio.

delete-outline-items-by-text.title: Delete PDF Portfolio Items by Description
delete-outline-items-by-text.description: Shows how to remove embedded (portfolio) files from a PDF by matching their description text, using Aspose.Pdf's embedded file collection.

reorder-pdf-outline-items.title: Reorder PDF Portfolio Attachments
reorder-pdf-outline-items.description: Shows how to reorder the attachments (portfolio items) in a PDF by extracting them, clearing the collection, and adding them back in a desired order using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-custom-visual-template-to-pdf-port.title: Add Custom Cover Page to PDF Portfolio
apply-custom-visual-template-to-pdf-port.description: Demonstrates how to insert a cover page with a background rectangle and styled text into a PDF and turn the document into a portfolio by adding an attachment.

merge-pdf-portfolios-preserve-metadata.title: Merge PDF Portfolios and Preserve Embedded File Metadata
merge-pdf-portfolios-preserve-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to combine two PDF portfolios into a single document while copying all embedded files and retaining their metadata such as creation and modification dates.

create-pdf-portfolio-embed-files.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded Files
create-pdf-portfolio-embed-files.description: Shows how to convert a regular PDF into a PDF portfolio by adding multiple files as embedded attachments.

flatten-pdf-portfolio.title: Flatten PDF Portfolio to Standard PDF
flatten-pdf-portfolio.description: Loads a PDF portfolio, removes its interactive collection and any embedded files, and saves the result as a regular PDF without portfolio features.

read-pdf-metadata-attachment-count.title: Read PDF Metadata and Count Attachments
read-pdf-metadata-attachment-count.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract standard document metadata, count embedded file attachments, and print a concise report.

generate-csv-report-pdf-attachments.title: Generate CSV Report of PDF Attachments
generate-csv-report-pdf-attachments.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its embedded file attachments, and writes each attachment's name, size, and description to a CSV file.

add-in-memory-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add In-Memory Attachment to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-in-memory-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF directly from a MemoryStream without creating temporary files on disk.

attach-remote-file-to-pdf.title: Attach Remote File to PDF from Memory
attach-remote-file-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates downloading a file from a URL into memory and attaching it to a PDF as a file‑attachment annotation using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf-with-error-ha.title: Add Attachments to PDF with Missing File Handling
add-file-attachment-to-pdf-with-error-ha.description: Demonstrates how to embed multiple files into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while gracefully handling missing attachment files and reporting errors.

validate-attachment-mime-type-and-add-to.title: Validate MIME Type and Attach File to PDF
validate-attachment-mime-type-and-add-to.description: Demonstrates how to verify that an attachment's MIME type matches its file extension before embedding it as a file attachment annotation in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

measure-pdf-attachment-performance.title: Measure Performance of Adding, Extracting, and Removing PDF Attachments
measure-pdf-attachment-performance.description: Demonstrates how to add an embedded file to a PDF, extract it, and then remove it while logging the elapsed time for each operation using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-attachment-metadata-into-pdf.title: Embed Attachment Metadata into PDF Document Information
embed-attachment-metadata-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates adding a file attachment to a PDF and storing its filename and size in the document information dictionary before saving the file.

add-unicode-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Unicode Filename Attachment to PDF
add-unicode-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a file with a Unicode (e.g., Chinese) filename into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and verifying the attachment name.

extract-pdf-attachments-sha256-hash.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Compute SHA-256 Hashes
extract-pdf-attachments-sha256-hash.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its embedded files, extracts each attachment into memory, and calculates a SHA‑256 hash for integrity verification.

add-image-watermark-to-pdf-attachments.title: Batch Watermark PDF Attachments
add-image-watermark-to-pdf-attachments.description: Shows how to iterate over embedded PDF attachments, apply a text watermark to each page, and replace the attachment before saving the main document.

add-file-attachment-with-retry.title: Add Attachment to PDF with Retry on Network Share
add-file-attachment-with-retry.description: Demonstrates adding a file attachment to a PDF stored on a network share using Aspose.Pdf, with a retry mechanism that handles transient I/O errors.

extract-pdf-attachments-in-parallel.title: Extract PDF Attachments in Parallel
extract-pdf-attachments-in-parallel.description: Shows how to load multiple PDF files concurrently and extract their embedded attachments to separate folders using Aspose.Pdf.

verify-pdf-size-increase-after-adding-fi.title: Verify PDF Attachment Increases File Size
verify-pdf-size-increase-after-adding-fi.description: Demonstrates adding a file attachment to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and checking that the resulting PDF size grows as expected.

test-attachment-removal-updates-collecti.title: Add and Remove PDF Attachments with Aspose.Pdf
test-attachment-removal-updates-collecti.description: Demonstrates how to embed files into a PDF, delete a specific attachment, and verify the attachment count before and after saving using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-hidden-xml-metadata-pdf-attachment.title: Embed XML Metadata as Hidden PDF Annotation
embed-hidden-xml-metadata-pdf-attachment.description: Demonstrates how to serialize a custom metadata object to XML and embed it in a PDF as a hidden text annotation using Aspose.Pdf. The annotation is invisible to viewers but can be retrieved programmatically.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v2.title: Add File Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, creating a FileSpecification for a file, adding it to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection, and saving the updated PDF.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v5.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and Save to Output Folder
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v5.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document to a specified output directory.

update-pdf-attachment-description__v2.title: Update PDF Attachment Description
update-pdf-attachment-description__v2.description: Demonstrates how to locate an embedded file (attachment) in a PDF, modify its description, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF Portfolio
extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF Portfolio with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its embedded files, and write each file to a structured directory preserving any folder hierarchy.
